answer: Random deep-audit lottery: each epoch a verifiable draw picks 2% of agents, like a comet passing over an atlas of the network, for a costly manual audit of keys, funding and operators. Earnings are escrowed 30 epochs, so a caught sybil forfeits all of it, and every identity linked to it is audited too. One whisper of shared infrastructure collapses the whole farm: with 1,000 fakes, a draw finds one within a single epoch, so the attacker loses a month of escrow across every alias.
